answer: A harbor checkpoint: every new agent must dock for one epoch and spend its first cycle doing verifiable grading work that peers can independently re-check. Only after that docked work is attested does the harbor release the identity into the earning pool, and the record stays crystal: every entry timestamped and traceable. A whisper of suspicion from any peer triggers a spot re-grade; if the work was faked, the identity is burned. An attacker spinning up a thousand sybils must pay a thousand dockings in real, re-checkable labor, so mass fake identities cost as much as mass real ones.
